note: Conditions are generated from `factors` x `design`, so the experiment is written down once instead of as N hand-copied command templates. A cell is named <chain>-<resolution>-<model> (e.g. `ros-4node-360p-m`). `--conditions` still selects a subset by cell name. If `factors` is absent the older flat `conditions` block is used instead.

resolution.note: Three re-encodes of the same clip at the same CRF, so bitrate (and therefore decode cost) scales with resolution. They are stored upright: ffmpeg baked the rotation into the pixels and cleared the display matrix, hence rotate 0. `clip_frames` is what makes the replay count exact instead of a 1000-loop fudge.

model.note: All three engines take FLOAT (1,3,640,640) and produce FLOAT (1,84,8400), so imgsz and input_dtype are constant across the matrix and the model axis moves zero bytes on the wire.

ros-4node.note: four-node chain (acquisition -> preprocessing -> inference -> postprocessing), one process each. The inference node owns the decode/threshold step, so compare `infer + post` against the monolith's two buckets. Prerequisite: `cd ws && colcon build --symlink-install`.
ros-4node.shell: source {repo}/ws/install/setup.bash && PYTHONPATH={repo}/monolith/yolocar/src:$PYTHONPATH ros2 launch yolocar_ros bench.launch.py model:={model} duration:={duration} loops:={loops} source:={source} rotate:={rotate} records:={out}/records.jsonl summary:={out}/summary.json log_level:=WARNING

design.note: The full factorial is 2 x 3 x 3 = 18 cells. It is listed in full so the file states the truth rather than a wish; `bench/README.md` has the cost per cell and the pruning recipes (`--conditions`, or a shorter `design`).

artifacts.note: Demo material, NOT measurement: `bench/run.py --demo` runs each condition once through one full replay of the clip with the detections sidecar on, then renders it offline with `yolocar.demo`. Nothing here touches the measured trials, so the measured commands above stay byte-identical.

monolith-ctrl.note: Same as `monolith`: two visually identical control videos are the noise floor, made visible.

run.shell: source {repo}/ws/install/setup.bash && PYTHONPATH={repo}/monolith/yolocar/src:$PYTHONPATH ros2 launch yolocar_ros bench.launch.py loops:={loops} duration:=-1 source:={source} rotate:={rotate} records:={out}/records.jsonl detections:={out}/detections.jsonl summary:={out}/summary.json log_level:=WARNING

compare.note: Side-by-side, each panel at its own pace (`--align wall`): the ROS panel stutters and the composite lasts as long as the slower run.
